title: Relative normalization commutes with smooth base change
statement: Let $f:U\to S$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes, $g:X\to S$ a smooth morphism, and $U\xrightarrow{i}N\xrightarrow{n}S$ the relative normalization [lem-weil-pbc-relative-normalization]. Let $k:U\times_S X\to X$ be the second projection and $N_k\to X$ its relative normalization. The canonical comparison $c:N_k\to N\times_S X$ is an isomorphism, and its composite with the second projection $N\times_S X\to X$ equals the normalization morphism $N_k\to X$.

proof.text: The canonical comparison is f.normalizationPullback g. Its being an isomorphism is the instance instIsIsoNormalizationPullbackOfSmooth. Its equation over X is normalizationPullback_snd. Apply these two existing Mathlib declarations, with no additional assumption on U or S.
